hypothesis: On one AWS Graviton4 c8g.4xlarge, matched Arm Performix profiles will independently observe KleidiAI kai_* execution only in the enabled Phi-4 Mini INT4 treatment and will produce renderable CPU, instruction and system characterizations without contradicting the accepted Linux perf attribution.
quality_ref: EXP-2026-009 accepted 770-item non-inferiority result; this experiment changes no model outputs or serving claim
primary_metric: matched Performix Code Hotspots positive/negative kai_* execution attribution
secondary_metrics: agreement with EXP-2026-009 Linux perf attribution
environment_ref: AWS Graviton4 c8g.4xlarge, Ubuntu 24.04 Arm64, CPU-only, pinned runtime lock
randomization: Treatments alternate by recipe; the first treatment is disabled for odd recipes and enabled for even recipes.
warmup_policy: One unprofiled profile_ort.py pass per treatment before all measured recipes.
profiler_ref: Arm Performix 1.20.0 Code Hotspots, CPU Microarchitecture, Instruction Mix and System Utilization recipes at default normal sampling
notes: This is required causal evidence for the reference Arm release. It does not replace or rerun the sustained fixed-SLO throughput experiment. Any missing required recipe, mismatched run, failed export or contradiction stops the Arm-specific submission claim. Thresholds were frozen before provisioning paid resources.
